name: evidence-emitter
description: Emit and verify a signed, offline-verifiable governance-evidence package: compose the installed loomground assurance components (enforcement posture, effect reconciliation, norm freshness, obligation discharge, oversight certificate, governance certification, 5d-nd) into one DSSE/in-toto statement whose subject is digest-bound; absent components are marked, not faked. Attests a compliance-fleet decision or a privacy-shield scan report. Default dev signer has zero authenticity; production Ed25519 takes host key material — no key is minted or embedded.
